verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between Ertugliflozin and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, mediated through multiple pathways. Ertugliflozin is reported to target the Interferon alpha/beta receptor (IFNAR), which in turn is a target of Bafilomycin A1 and of (4S,4aR,6R,7R,7aS)-2,4,7-trimethyl-1,3,4,4a,5,6,7,7a-octahydrocyclopenta[c]pyridin-6-ol. Both of these compounds are known to interact with the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. Additionally, Ertugliflozin is also reported to target IFNAR, which is also a target of benzyl benzoate, another compound that interacts with the same transporter. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanisms and the role of each intermediate compound in the pathway remain to be fully elucidated. The evidence suggests a possible functional link between Ertugliflozin and the transporter, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and the role of each component in the pathway.
